modules.title: 关键帧指定了哪些状态点

items.title: 过渡只有两态
items.text: 从初始状态到目标状态，由悬停、点击等切换触发，播放一次就停。

items.title: 关键帧可以多态并循环
items.text: 在 @keyframes 写 0%、50%、100% 等状态点；要循环，还需另设 animation-iteration-count。

items.title: 读代码找状态点
items.text: 百分比是作者指定的时间点；浏览器只会对可动画插值的属性计算中间值，不支持插值的属性可能离散切换。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 关键帧负责“有哪些状态”，缓动负责“中间怎么走”。同一段旋转，配不同的缓动曲线，转速手感完全不同。

lessonPractice.title: 要让一个加载图标无限循环旋转。用哪种写法更合适？

options.label: 用关键帧：指定 0% 和 100% 两个状态，设置无限循环
options.feedback: 对。循环播放需要关键帧；过渡只在状态切换时播放一次，不会自己循环。

options.label: 用过渡，刷新页面时就会一直转
options.feedback: 过渡由状态变化触发，只播一次；不会自动循环。

options.label: 放多张图片快速切换，模拟旋转
options.feedback: 帧动画成本高且不流畅；一个旋转用关键帧即可表达。

en.title: A loading icon should rotate in an infinite loop. Which approach fits better?

options.label: Use keyframes: specify 0% and 100% states and set infinite looping
options.feedback: Correct. Looping playback needs keyframes; a transition plays once on a state change and does not loop by itself.

options.label: Use a transition; it will keep rotating when the page refreshes
options.feedback: A transition is triggered by state changes and plays once; it does not loop automatically.

options.label: Swap many images rapidly to simulate rotation
options.feedback: Frame-by-frame images are costly and choppy; a rotation is expressed with keyframes.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请让加载图标循环旋转：用 @keyframes 指定旋转状态，再单独设置 animation-iteration-count: infinite。改完确认它循环播放，并响应系统“减少动效”设置。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Make the loading icon rotate in a loop: use @keyframes for its states and set animation-iteration-count: infinite. Also respect the system's reduced-motion preference; confirm the icon's movement changes when that setting is on.

learning.assumes: You have seen looping animations on pages, or AI implementing animation with @keyframes.
learning.outcome: Given a piece of animation code, you can point out which state points it specifies.

modules.title: Which state points the keyframes specify

items.title: A transition has only two states
items.text: From initial to target state, triggered by hover or click; it plays once and stops.

items.title: Keyframes can specify many states
items.text: Specify points at 0%, 50%, and 100%; set animation-iteration-count separately if it should loop.

items.title: Read the code for state points
items.text: Percentages inside @keyframes are the specified points; the browser interpolates between them for animatable properties, while other properties may switch discretely.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Keyframes decide which states exist; easing decides how the middle plays out. The same rotation with different easing curves feels completely different in speed.

distinctions.label: Transition
distinctions.text: A transition commonly animates a start and end state after a state change; @keyframes can specify multiple points, while repeat count is set by animation properties such as animation-iteration-count.

distinctions.label: Easing
distinctions.text: Easing decides the rhythm curve of the middle; keyframes decide which state points exist. They work together but are not the same.
